entries.0cc3ce04c8a3e80c: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Fuji Hensokuki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells reduction gears and similar products. The company purchases some reduction gears as parts for electric blinds. The company is also developing reduction gears and servo motor units for automated guided vehicles (AGVs) for automation and labor-saving in factories and warehouses. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,602 million.

entries.19577a12c53ae07c: This is the core business of the company group, in which the company manufactures and sells various blinds, movable partitions, curtain rails and other products, and performs interior construction work. Parts for blinds and partitions and some products are manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries Tachikawa Kiko Co., Ltd. and Fuji Hensokuki Co., Ltd., and the processing and assembly of fabric blinds are outsourced to Tachikawa Hukou Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Shiga Tachikawa Hukou Kogyo Co., Ltd. Installation and some sales are handled by Tachikawa Soubi Co., Ltd., export and import of products and parts by Tachikawa Trading Co., Ltd., and part of inventory management by Tachikawa Service Co., Ltd.; in China, Tachikawa Chuangshi Industry (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells blinds. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥35,944 million.

entries.3f6c45e41c8075b5: The Interior and Exterior Products Business is the core of revenue, and its external customer revenue of ¥35,944 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025 accounts for about 84% of consolidated revenue. The Speed Reducer Business follows with ¥3,602 million, and the Parking Equipment Business with ¥3,076 million. By region, external customer revenue in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, and sales to domestic customers make up the majority. No specific counterparty accounts for more than 10% of external customer revenue. The Interior and Exterior Products Business is affected by conditions in the construction and housing industry, such as trends in the number of newly built housing starts.
entries.4dc0be064adbe278: It sells interior and exterior products for buildings such as detached houses, condominiums, office buildings and commercial stores, and sells speed reducers to manufacturers of industrial machinery and others. entries.52dc802d11a0e257: The company manufactures and sells movable partitions and curtain rails. It has handled the simple partition "Accordion Curtain" for general residential use since 1964.
entries.5373425e46facc78: It has formulated the medium-term management plan “Tachikawa Vision 2028 – Creating Comfortable Living,” covering the three years from fiscal 2026, and states that, as a manufacturer, it will focus on monozukuri and market creation, investment for growth, and social contribution. In the Interior and Exterior Products Business, it states that it will push sales of value-added products such as light-control fabric products, motorized products and panel partitions for which demand is expected to grow, advance development at its technology research building, make use of the Shinjuku showroom opened in January 2026, and capture renovation demand through M&A and alliances in new business areas. In the Speed Reducer Business, it states that it will expand sales of the servo motor business acquired in January 2024 and strengthen set sales with speed reducers. In the Parking Equipment Business, it states that it will focus on promoting the wide range of specifications of “Pazuru Tawā,” pursuing mutual sales alliances, and winning remodeling and renovation projects.

entries.6b65437dbf4da5c9: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥42,623 million, up 2.9% year on year. By business, the Interior and Exterior Products Business was ¥35,944 million, the Speed Reducer Business ¥3,602 million, and the Parking Equipment Business ¥3,076 million.

entries.8989a6e83347ce98: Based on the division of roles among group companies in [Description of Business], external customer revenue by reportable segment in the segment information, and the descriptions of the technology research building and product renewal in the overview of operating results in MD&A.
entries.9dda0131f50fe9ff: A structure is in place in which consolidated subsidiaries share, within the group, the manufacture of parts, processing and assembly of fabric blinds, installation, import and export, and inventory management, allowing the company to concentrate on manufacturing and selling products. At the technology research building, which began operating in October 2024, it conducts evaluations assuming various conditions such as environmental resistance and light-blocking performance, and uses them to improve the quality and speed of development. On the product side, it has substantially renewed the fabric designs of its core roll screens and vertical blinds and has assembled a product lineup linked to creating comfortable environments, including light-adjustable fabric products and battery-powered motorized products.
